# Load packages

```{r}
# Check if 'pacman' is installed; if not, install it
if (!require(pacman)) {
  install.packages("pacman")
}

# Load required packages using pacman
pacman::p_load(
  tidyverse,     # Data wrangling and visualization
  binom,         # Binomial confidence intervals
  glue,          # String interpolation
  here,          # Relative file paths
  patchwork,     # Combine ggplots
  modelsummary,  # Summarizing model outputs
  #tinytable,     # Light tables
  #zipcodeR,       # ZIP code utilities
  arrow, # Apache Parquet
  DiagrammeR, # Diagramme
  DiagrammeRsvg, 
  rsvg
)

# Load tidylog for transparent logging
library("tidylog", warn.conflicts = FALSE)

# Load GitHub package
devtools::install_github("graemeblair/stdidx")
library(stdidx)

# Plotting settings
options(es.use_symbols = TRUE)
source(here("functions", "utils.r"))
ggplot2::theme_set(custom_theme())
```

# Create a diagramme 

```{r}
graph <- grViz("
digraph civic_pipeline {
  graph [rankdir = TB, layout = dot]
  node [shape = box, style = filled, fontname = Helvetica, fontsize = 12]

  // Raw Data Sources
  IRS       [label = 'IRS Master Business File', fillcolor = lightblue]
  filings   [label = 'Digitized 990 Filings', fillcolor = lightblue]
  urls      [label = 'Organizational URLs', fillcolor = lightblue]
  about     [label = 'Organizational About Pages', fillcolor = lightblue]

  // Data Extraction
  search      [label = 'Find URLs via Bing Search API', fillcolor = white]
  scrape      [label = 'Extract Website Texts', fillcolor = white]
  extractXML  [label = 'Extract XMLs', fillcolor = white]
  extractGeo  [label = 'Extract Geolocations', fillcolor = white]

  // Derived Datasets
  corpus    [label = 'Descriptive Text Corpus', fillcolor = palegreen]
  geolocate [label = 'Geolocations', fillcolor = palegreen]
  activities [label = 'Organizational Activities', fillcolor = palegreen]

  // Data Transformation
  nlp       [label = 'Rule-based Classification (NLP)', fillcolor = gainsboro]
  ml        [label = 'Supervised Classification (ML)', fillcolor = gainsboro]

  // Final Datasets
  classification [label = 'Organizational Classification', fillcolor = khaki]
  dataset   [label = 'Civic Opportunity Datasets', fillcolor = khaki]

  // Main Flow Edges
  IRS -> filings
  IRS -> search
  search -> urls
  urls -> about
  about -> scrape
  scrape -> corpus
  filings -> extractXML
  extractXML -> corpus
  urls -> extractGeo
  extractGeo -> geolocate
  IRS -> extractGeo
  corpus -> nlp
  corpus -> ml
  nlp -> activities
  ml -> classification
  activities -> dataset
  geolocate -> dataset
  geolocate -> classification

  // Invisible anchor to pull legend to top right
  anchor [style=invis, width=0, height=0]

  // Legend cluster (fully internal)
  subgraph cluster_legend {
    label = 'Type'
    fontsize = 12
    style = dashed
    color = gray

    legend1 [label = 'Raw Data Sources', fillcolor = lightblue, style = filled, shape = box]
    legend2 [label = 'Derived Datasets', fillcolor = palegreen, style = filled, shape = box]
    legend3 [label = 'Final Datasets', fillcolor = khaki, style = filled, shape = box]
    legend4 [label = 'Data Extraction', fillcolor = white, style = filled, shape = box]
    legend5 [label = 'Data Transformation', fillcolor = gainsboro, style = filled, shape = box]

    legend1 -> legend2 [style=invis]
    legend2 -> legend3 [style=invis]
    legend3 -> legend4 [style=invis]
    legend4 -> legend5 [style=invis]
    anchor -> legend1 [style=invis]
  }
}
")

# Convert to SVG, then to PNG
svg <- export_svg(graph)
charToRaw(svg) %>% rsvg_png(here("plots", "figure1.png"))
```

# Import data 

```{r}
# Organization data derived from anonymized IRS tax records and associated websites
ind_org_df <- arrow::read_parquet(here("raw_data", "ind_org_df.parquet"))

nrow(ind_org_df)

names(ind_org_df)
```

```{r}
# SDOH (2017???2021 ACS adapted by CDC)

# County-level
sdoh_county <- read_csv(here("raw_data", "sdoh_county.csv")) %>%
  select(StateAbbr, StateDesc, LocationID, MeasureID, Data_Value, TotalPopulation, Geolocation) 

sdoh_county_wide <- sdoh_county %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = MeasureID, values_from = Data_Value)

# ZIP code-level
sdoh_zcta <- read_csv(here("raw_data", "sdoh_zcta.csv")) %>%
  select(LocationID, MeasureID, Data_Value, TotalPopulation, Geolocation) 

sdoh_zcta_wide <- sdoh_zcta %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = MeasureID, values_from = Data_Value)
```

# Transform data 

```{r}
nrow(ind_org_df)          # ~1.8M organizations
mean(ind_org_df$is_po)    # ~23% use P.O. boxes
```

```{r}
# Compare predictions: all orgs vs. non-P.O. box orgs
df_all <- get_predicted_percent_ci(ind_org_df, "All organizations")
df_box <- get_predicted_percent_ci(ind_org_df %>% filter(is_po != 1), "Excluding P.O. Box")

comparison_df <- bind_rows(df_all, df_box)
comparison_df
```

```{r}
# Save the plot using the png() function
png(filename = here("plots", "s1.png"), width = 1400, height = 1200, res = 100)

ggplot(comparison_df, aes(x = predicted, y = percent, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = lower_percent, ymax = upper_percent),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    width = 0.25,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Predicted Category Distribution with 95% Confidence Intervals",
    x = "Predicted Category",
    y = "Percentage (%)",
    fill = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1))

dev.off()
```

```{r}
# Compare prediction shares
left_join(
  ind_org_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(predicted)) %>%
    count(predicted) %>%
    mutate(percent = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
    select(predicted, percent),
  ind_org_df %>%
    filter(is_po != 1, !is.na(predicted)) %>%
    count(predicted) %>%
    mutate(without_po_percent = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
    select(predicted, without_po_percent)
)
```



```{r}
# Filter out PO Box orgs
ind_org_df <- ind_org_df %>%
  filter(is_po != 1)

nrow(ind_org_df)  # 1,363,701
```
  
# Create datasets

```{r}
# Civic opportunity flag and score
ind_org_df <- ind_org_df %>%
  mutate(
    opp_binary = ifelse(volunteer == 1 | membership == 1 | take_action == 1 | events == 1, 1, 0),
    opp_mean = idx_mean(volunteer, membership, take_action, events)
  )

civic_orgs <- ind_org_df %>%
  filter(opp_binary == 1)
```

## The second datasets (what organizations do)

### County 

```{r}
cnts_counts <- ind_org_df %>%
  group_by(FIPS, grouping_value, state) %>%
  summarise(
    b = max(opp_binary, na.rm = TRUE),
    m = max(opp_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    volunteer_m = max(volunteer, na.rm = TRUE),
    membership_m = max(membership, na.rm = TRUE),
    take_action_m = max(take_action, na.rm = TRUE),
    events_m = max(events, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  group_by(FIPS, state) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    civic_org_sum = sum(b),
    civic_opp_sum = sum(m),
    volunteer_sum = sum(volunteer_m),
    membership_sum = sum(membership_m),
    take_action_sum = sum(take_action_m),
    events_sum = sum(events_m)
  )

(cnts_counts %>%
  filter(n != 0, civic_org_sum == 0) %>%
  nrow()) / (nrow(cnts_counts)) # 3% of counties are civic deserts 
```

```{r}
cnts_counts_cov <- cnts_counts %>%
  left_join(sdoh_county_wide %>%
              select(-StateDesc), 
            by = c("FIPS" = "LocationID",
                   "state" = "StateAbbr")) 

cnts_counts_cov <- cnts_counts_cov %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
         civic_org_sum_normalized = 100000 * civic_org_sum/TotalPopulation, 
         civic_opp_sum_normalized = 100000 * civic_opp_sum/TotalPopulation,
         civic_opp_index = dplyr::ntile(civic_opp_sum_normalized, 5),
         volunteer_sum_normalized = 100000 * volunteer_sum/TotalPopulation,
         membership_sum_normalized = 100000 * membership_sum/TotalPopulation,
         take_action_sum_normalized = 100000 * take_action_sum/TotalPopulation,
         events_sum_normalized = 100000 * events_sum/TotalPopulation
         )

round(mean(cnts_counts$n == 0), 2) # all these counties have an organization 
round(mean(cnts_counts$civic_opp_sum == 0), 2) # 3% of the counties do not have any organization offering civic opportunity 

cnts_counts_cov <- cnts_counts_cov %>%
  select(-c("HCOST", "CROWD", "AGE65"))

length(setdiff(cnts_counts$FIPS, sdoh_county_wide$LocationID)) # 78 counties are missing
78/3281 # 2%
```

```{r}
# Save datasets
write_csv(cnts_counts_cov %>% select(-matches("Geo")), here("data_outputs", "cnty_counts_cov.csv"))
write_csv(cnts_counts_cov %>% select(-matches("Geo")), here("data_outputs", "cnty_counts_cov.rds"))
```

### ZIP code

```{r}
zcta_counts <- ind_org_df %>%
  group_by(ZCTA, grouping_value, state) %>%
  summarise(
    m = max(opp_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    b = max(opp_binary, na.rm = TRUE),
    volunteer_m = max(volunteer, na.rm = TRUE),
    membership_m = max(membership, na.rm = TRUE),
    take_action_m = max(take_action, na.rm = TRUE),
    events_m = max(events, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  group_by(ZCTA, state) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    civic_org_sum = sum(b),
    civic_opp_sum = sum(m),
    volunteer_sum = sum(volunteer_m),
    membership_sum = sum(membership_m),
    take_action_sum = sum(take_action_m),
    events_sum = sum(events_m)
  )

(zcta_counts %>%
  filter(n != 0, civic_org_sum == 0) %>%
  nrow()) / (nrow(zcta_counts)) # 17% of ZIP codes are civic deserts 
```

```{r}
zcta_counts_cov <- zcta_counts %>%
  left_join(sdoh_zcta_wide, by = c("ZCTA" = "LocationID")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    civic_org_sum_normalized = 100000 * civic_org_sum / TotalPopulation,
    civic_opp_sum_normalized = 100000 * civic_opp_sum / TotalPopulation,
    civic_opp_index = ntile(civic_opp_sum_normalized, 5),
    volunteer_sum_normalized = 100000 * volunteer_sum / TotalPopulation,
    membership_sum_normalized = 100000 * membership_sum / TotalPopulation,
    take_action_sum_normalized = 100000 * take_action_sum / TotalPopulation,
    events_sum_normalized = 100000 * events_sum / TotalPopulation
  ) %>%
  select(-c("HCOST", "CROWD", "AGE65"))

length(setdiff(zcta_counts$ZCTA, sdoh_zcta_wide$LocationID)) # 2,980 ZIP codes are missing
2980/30988 # 10%
```

```{r}
# Save datasets
write_csv(zcta_counts_cov %>% select(-Geolocation), here("data_outputs", "zcta_counts_cov.csv"))
write_csv(zcta_counts_cov %>% select(-Geolocation), here("data_outputs", "zcta_counts_cov.rds"))
```

## The third datasets (what organizations are)

```{r}
class_vec <- c("arts", "civic", "community", "econ", "education", "foundation",
               "health", "hobby", "housing", "professional", "religious",
               "research", "socialfraternal", "unions", "youth")

civic_orgs <- civic_orgs %>%
  #filter(!is.na(predicted)) %>%
  mutate(class = case_match(predicted,
                            class_vec[1] ~ "Arts & Cultural",
                            class_vec[2] ~ "Political",
                            class_vec[3] ~ "Community",
                            class_vec[4] ~ "Economic",
                            class_vec[5] ~ "Education",
                            class_vec[6] ~ "Foundations",
                            class_vec[7] ~ "Healthcare",
                            class_vec[8] ~ "Hobby & Sports",
                            class_vec[9] ~ "Housing",
                            class_vec[10] ~ "Professional",
                            class_vec[11] ~ "Religious",
                            class_vec[12] ~ "Research & Think Tank",
                            class_vec[13] ~ "Social & Fraternal",
                            class_vec[14] ~ "Unions",
                            class_vec[15] ~ "Youth"))
```

### County

```{r}
cnty_civic_org_type <- civic_orgs %>%
  group_by(FIPS, class) %>%
  count() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(FIPS) %>%
  mutate(freq = n/sum(n)) %>%
  group_by(FIPS) %>%
  mutate(primary_org_cat = class[which.max(freq)]) %>%
  ungroup()

write_csv(cnty_civic_org_type, here("data_outputs", "cnty_civic_org_type.csv"))
write_rds(cnty_civic_org_type, here("data_outputs", "cnty_civic_org_type.rds"))
```

#### Dashboard 

```{r}
cnty_civic_org_type_dashboard <- civic_orgs %>%
  group_by(state, FIPS, class) %>%
  count() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(FIPS) %>%
  mutate(freq = n/sum(n)) %>%
  group_by(FIPS) %>%
  mutate(primary_org_cat = class[which.max(freq)]) %>%
  ungroup()

cnty_civic_type_dashboard <- cnty_civic_org_type_dashboard %>%
  left_join(sdoh_county_wide %>%
              select(-StateDesc), 
            by = c("FIPS" = "LocationID",
                   "state" = "StateAbbr")) %>% # n
  select(state, FIPS, class, n, freq, primary_org_cat, TotalPopulation) %>%
  mutate(normalized_n = n/TotalPopulation) %>%
  select(state, FIPS, class, n, normalized_n, freq, primary_org_cat, TotalPopulation)

# export CSV
write_csv(cnty_civic_type_dashboard, here("data_outputs", "cnty_civic_type_dashboard.csv"))
```
